what.text: This page follows refugees from Georgia living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7510 Georgian refugees in France, 43.4% of all refugees from Georgia.
France is the largest host of Georgian refugees, followed by Germany, the United States and Ireland.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflicts in Georgia over the government from 1991 to 1993 and over Abkhazia territory in 1992 and 1993.
It also records armed conflict over South Ossetia territory in 1992, 2004 and 2008.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 43 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
